title: Sesame Crusted Bamboo Bites
description: Delicious bite-sized bamboo pieces coated with a crunchy sesame crust, perfect as a snack.
instructions: Steam the bamboo shoots for 5-7 minutes, or until tender.
In a small bowl, mix together sesame seeds and lemony oil.
Dip each bamboo piece into the sesame mixture, coating evenly.
Place coated bamboo pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until sesame crust is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
Cook pilaf rice according to package instructions, if serving as a side dish.
